text:
Priya Shah: Heads up — during yesterday's backfill a handful of routes kept honoring old quota multipliers after the merge. Repro steps below, curious if anyone else saw this.
Marcus Li: saw something similar in staging late Friday. looked like a propagation race between the config-applier job and route-cache TTL.
Priya Shah: repro: `curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwoodsvc/v1/configs/merge -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"target_scope":"route","changes":[{"id":"r-123","quota_multiplier":0.5}]}'` then run `kc exec -it applier -- tail -n 200 /var/log/applier.log` -> you can see apply succeeded but route continued using old multiplier for ~30s.
Ben Ortiz: that sounds like we need clearer semantics on merge vs replace. partial merges of nested fields are risky (arrays, maps). I'd prefer explicit semantics: merge_mode enum (merge|replace) + optional CAS etag.
Dana Morales: for console UX we should show last-applied etag and a diff preview before commit. also a dry-run toggle that produces a preview of affected routes and approximate token cost impact.
Marcus Li: dry-run on full population is expensive for big customers (100k+ routes). propose we support sampled dry-runs (e.g. cohort sampling) + telemetry gating: run full dry-run behind an ops job or in shadow.
Priya Shah: we already emit metrics `config.apply_success` and `config.drift_count`. console could plot drift_count by config-id and surface anomalies post-merge.
Ben Ortiz: API sketch: PATCH /v1/configs/{id}?merge_mode=merge&dry_run=true body=... -> response includes preview: {applied:false, preview:{changes:[{route:"r-123", before:..., after:...}]}, conflicts:[] } (409 on etag mismatch).
Priya Shah: edge-case: backfills that touch nested arrays (ex: route.priority_nodes) get merged incorrectly by our naive fieldwise merge. must define array merge semantics in the contract or disallow merging arrays.
Marcus Li: migration plan idea: accept both legacy merge (current behavior) and new strict-mode. default new clients to strict-mode, keep legacy for 3 releases, emit deprecation header.
Dana Morales: ops request: we should run a shadow-apply flow first — apply to a replica cluster that doesn't change routing, collect apply metrics and drift counts for 24h. ops-bot can schedule cohorts.
ops-bot: Shadow-apply scheduled: shadow-1 cohort on 2026-06-15T01:00:00Z. Runner: config-applier-v2 (dry-run mode = false, shadow=true).
Priya Shah: console wishlist: when expanding scope (user -> org) show estimated affected route count and require a confirmation modal. also surface a quick query to preview SLO impact window.
Ben Ortiz: also add an endpoint to estimate token/cost delta for a proposed config change. rough heuristics are fine (sampled token rate * delta multiplier).
Marcus Li: who wants doc + API changes? assigning @Ben + @Priya to draft RFC + API spec. I'll file the runbook for rollback triggers (e.g., drift_count > 0.5% sustained for 10m, increased 5xxs).
Priya Shah: :thumbsup: will draft RFC, include telemetry queries, sample sizes for shadow cohorts, and a minimal console mock.
Dana Morales: quick Q — how do we handle etag collisions? return 409 with current etag and a preview of conflicting fields? that seems reasonable.
Ben Ortiz: yes — 409 + body {current:..., attempted:..., conflicts:[field paths]} so console can show a merge conflict UI.
Priya Shah: Also propose an API param `audit_id` so the applier can attach backfill job ids to metrics for easier tracing.
Marcus Li: agreed. can we also emit a synthetic span for the merge operation so tracing shows end-to-end latency?
Priya Shah: yep, add trace/span id to response when not in dry-run.
Dana Morales: I'll add a console banner to opt-in shadow rollouts per workspace.
Ben Ortiz: rough API stub I'll add to the RFC PR tonight. example: `PATCH /v1/configs/{id}` body: `{ "merge_mode": "merge", "dry_run": true, "changes": [...] }` response: `{ "applied": false, "preview": {"changed_routes": 12, "samples": [...]}, "conflicts": [] }`
Priya Shah: thanks everyone. let's sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize rollout plan. I'll post a draft RFC link in this thread when ready. :eyes:
Marcus Li: see you then, adding a quick checklist to the RFC: metrics to monitor, sample queries, rollback steps, ops contact.
Dana Morales: pinging @ops-bot once RFC lands so ops can reserve shadow capacity.
Priya Shah: end of thread — will follow up with RFC link.
